get.summary:
Retrieves collections. If tmdbId is provided returns the single matching collection;
otherwise returns all collections.

parameters.name: tmdbId
parameters.description: Optional TMDB collection id to filter by.

put.summary: Bulk update for multiple collections. Only properties present in the request are applied.

requestBody.description: The update resource containing collection ids and the properties to change.
The collection resource containing updated values. The resource's Id is used to locate the existing collection.

delete.summary: Deletes a collection and their associated movies/scenes from Whisparr

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The internal ID of the colection to delete

parameters.name: deleteFiles
parameters.description: If true, associated movie/scene files will also be deleted from disk

parameters.name: addImportExclusion
parameters.description: If true, an import exclusion will be added to prevent re-adding the collection in future imports

get.summary:
Retrieves credits filtered by movie id, movie metadata id, or performer id.
If multiple filters are provided, precedence is: movieMetadataId, movieId, performerId.
If no filters are provided, all credits are returned.

parameters.name: movieId
parameters.description: Optional internal movie id to filter credits by movie.

parameters.name: movieMetadataId
parameters.description: Optional movie metadata id to filter credits by metadata record.

parameters.name: performerId
parameters.description: Optional performer foreign id to filter credits by performer.

get.description: Search movies by clean title (or foreign ID)

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search query, which can be a clean title or a foreign ID

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of search results to return (default is 100)

get.description: Look up movies by TMDB ID, TPDB ID, or Stash ID. If no query parameters are provided, returns all movies.

Get a single movie by foreign Id or internal Id. If the ID starts with "tmdb:", it will be treated as a TMDB ID. Otherwise, it will first attempt to find by foreign ID, then fallback to internal ID for backward compatibility.

parameters.name: moveFiles
parameters.description: Whether to move the movie files to a new location

requestBody.description: The movie resource with updated information. The ID in the resource must match the ID in the URL.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the movie to update

requestBody.description: The patch request containing the monitored flag

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the movie to delete

parameters.name: deleteFiles
parameters.description: Whether to delete the movie files from disk

parameters.name: addImportExclusion
parameters.description: Whether to add an import exclusion for the movie's path to prevent re-importing if files are left on disk

post.description: Look up movies by a list of foreignIds

requestBody.description: List of foreign IDs to look up

get.description:
Returns statistics for the item type, including total count, monitored count, file count, and total file size.
            If itemType is specified, returns stats for that item type instead of movies + scenes.

parameters.name: itemType
parameters.description: Optional query parameter to specify whether to return stats for movies or scenes. Defaults to movies if not provided.

parameters.name: monitored
parameters.description: The monitored value to set for the specified movies

requestBody.description: List of movie IDs to update
List of movie IDs to retrieve

parameters.name: performerForeignId
parameters.description: The foreign ID of the performer (e.g. "tmdb-12345")

parameters.name: studioForeignId
parameters.description: The foreign ID of the studio (e.g. "tmdb-12345")

post.description: Paged, filtered, and sorted movie/scene results

post.summary:
Imports the provided list of movie resources into the application.
Each resource must include a valid filesystem path to an existing movie file.
Files will be moved/renamed according to configured naming rules and root folders,
metadata will be augmented from configured providers, and the movies will be added to the library.

requestBody.description: List of Whisparr.Api.V3.Movies.MovieResource objects describing movies to import.
